scope: Retrospective train/development only; consumed test excluded

contracts.common_mask: nominal16+10k ms targets; t>=64ms and t+32ms<=N

f0_strata.edges: lower-inclusive upper-exclusive except400..700 includes700; outside50..700 stays in denominator

contracts.aggregation: pool recording counts within each speaker/condition, then equal48train/equal16development cells; missing stratum denominators explicit
contracts.frozen_voicing_oracle: Reference chooses a covered pitch only when original p(voiced)>=.5; cannot fix false-unvoiced or reference-unvoiced gate-positive errors
contracts.unconstrained_coverage: Reference-voiced proposal hit rate ignoring original voicing; separate from any realizable selector. selected_mlp_or_raw_yin uses the actually emitted MLP pitch (missing when gate is off); six_candidates and raw_yin are input-only ungated proposals.
contracts.perfect_pitch_ceiling: Assumes perfect unbounded pitch at every gate-positive voiced target, even outside supported50..700Hz; theoretical voicing-only ceiling
contracts.raw_yin: Historical cached Python librosa raw YIN; not substituted by repaired browser float64 implementation

prefit_gate.metric: equal16cell original-six frozen-voicing oracle joint-error reduction vs original MLP
prefit_gate.grouping_coverage_gate: Not assessed by this audit; separate experiment prerequisite

limitations: Oracles use reference outcomes; headroom does not demonstrate learnability, calibrated confidence, or prospective improvement.
Training scores are resubstitution; development is repeatedly inspected exploratory data. No fresh holdout evaluation or test reference access.
Nominal provider reference validity/alignment retained; no offset fitting, reference repair or outcome-based exclusions.
No new training or model search. Original train forward pass only; development reused exactly.
